      Nested Classes 
      Modifier and Type Class Description
      static class  EloPeripheralManager.ExtHubType
      Used to handle external USB hub, the operation including: - enable/disable USB port - open cash drawer - control DP lanes to switch DP+USB2.0 and USB3.0 - hot plug detection The external USB hub list: - POS hub (for hand held models) - IO hub (for i-series and USBC models) - POS stand hub with CFD (for i-series and USBC project) - POS stand hub without CFD (for i-series and USBC project) - Flip stand hub (for i-series and USBC project)

      • ACTION_DISPLAY_PORT_CHANGED

        public static final java.lang.String ACTION_DISPLAY_PORT_CHANGED

        Broadcast Action for multiple display port of backpack model

        This will be sent when display port state changed, including:
        • 1. active display port changed.
        • 2. primary display port changed.
        • 3. Hot plug about DP and HDMI, which will cause connected display port changed.
        The intent will have the following extra value:
        • primary_display_port - the primary display port, which defined in EloPeripheralManager.DisplayPort
        • active_display_port - the active display port, which defined in EloPeripheralManager.DisplayPort
        • available_display_ports - connected display ports, which defined in EloPeripheralManager.DisplayPort
        See Also:
        Constant Field Values

      • ACTION_POE_CHANGED

        public static final java.lang.String ACTION_POE_CHANGED

        Broadcast Action: power source switched into or out of PoE.

        To save power when power source is PoE, device will disable some functions, such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, GPS, HDMI output, GPIO output and USB hub ports. when power source switched to AC adapter, recovery these functions to the last state. The intent will have the following extra value:

        • state - A boolean value indicating whether PoE is on.

        See Also:
        Constant Field Values

      • getPoeCtl

        @NonNull
public EloPeripheralManager.PoE getPoeCtl()
        The PoE instance to control PoE power and check whether the power source is PoE.

        These models support PoE feature:

        "i4_in10_std" (i-series 4.0)

        "i4_in15_std" (i-series 4.0)

        "i4_in22_std" (i-series 4.0)

      • isPoeOn

        public boolean isPoeOn()
        Whether the power source is PoE now.

        Note: this API for SDK backward compatibility, you can use getPoeCtl.isPoeOn() directly

        Returns:
        true if power source is PoE, and false if power source is AC adapter.

        Note1: If current model supports PoE feature (e.g. model is "i4_in10_std"), but not plug-in PoE module, force return false.

        Note2: If current model doesn't support PoE feature (e.g. model is "i4_bpack") , force return false.

      • getUsbPortCtl

        @NonNull
public EloPeripheralManager.UsbPort getUsbPortCtl()
        Get the USB port instance to enable/disable data role and power role of USB port that on the main board.

        Hand held models (mpos) don't support usb port enable/disable feature

        These models support usb port enable/disable feature:

        "i4_in10_std" (i-series 4.0)

        "i4_in15_std" (i-series 4.0)

        "i4_in22_std" (i-series 4.0)

        "i4_in15_usbc" (i-series 4.0 type C)

        "i4_bpack" (backpack)

      • getExtUsbPortCtl

        @NonNull
public EloPeripheralManager.ExtUsbPort getExtUsbPortCtl()
        Get the external USB port instance to enable/disable data role and power role of USB port that on the external USB hub and these external USB hubs support hot plug. These models support external usb port enable/disable feature:

        "i4_in15_usbc" (i-series 4.0 type C)

        "i4-in15-mundy" (i-series 4.0 mundy)

        "m50_nonpayment_cell" (handheld nonpayment)

        "m50_nonpayment_cellna" (handheld nonpayment)

        "m50_nonpayment_wifi" (handheld nonpayment)

        "m60_payment_cell" (handheld payment)

        "m60_payment_cellna" (handheld payment)

        "m60_payment_wifi" (handheld payment)

      • getExtLedCtl

        @NonNull
public EloPeripheralManager.ExtLed getExtLedCtl()
        Get the external LED instance to turn on/off the status light kit which connects to i-series with micro-usb ports or GPIO port

        Note:

        1. When user enable external LED, platform will turn on power for the given micro-usb ports automatically.

        2. if SLK LED is on, SLK LED's usb ports will not off when power source changed to PoE

        These models support external LED feature for Status Light Kit (SLK):

        "i4_in10_std" (i-series 4.0)

        "i4_in15_std" (i-series 4.0)

        "i4_in22_std" (i-series 4.0)
